test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 14 people buy item A while 13 people buy item B. Two people buy both items. How many people are there in all?
solution:
**Given**

n(A) = 14

n(B) = 13

n(A ∩ B) = **2**

**Formula used**

n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A ∩ B)

**Calculation**

n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A ∩ B)

⇒ 14 + 13 - 2

⇒ 27 - 2

⇒ 25

**∴ There are 25 people in all.**
